#summary Distribution, Requirment and Setup of the library.
#labels Deprecated,Phase-Deploy

= Distribution: =

Archives with the library is available from next sites:
  * [http://google.code.com/p/chair/]
  * [http://sourceforge.net/projects/chair/]
  * [http://chair.sourceforge.net/]

= Requirements: =

  * Apache HTTP Server
  * PHP 5

= Setup: =
   
   # Go to the directory where you plan to host your project.
   # Download or copy archive with the chair distribution to this direcotory.
   # Unpack it.
   # Now you have system ready for usage.

== Notes: ==

You have to be sure that Apache HTTP server configured properly:
  * mod_rewrite enabled
  * AllowOverride All set for the chair-0.1.1 directory

If you need another site location, you have to do next steps:
  * Move chair-0.1.1 directory content to some/directory
  * Change .htaccess Rewrite base set to /some/direcotory
  * AllowOverride All set for some/directory
